name: remnawave-mcp
description: Remnawave 3.x panel in Claude: users, nodes, traffic, devices, GeoCheck. Read-only, secrets and client data hidden.
long_description:
Ask about your Remnawave panel in plain language: online users, offline nodes, traffic, a client's subscription and devices, suspected subscription sharing, GeoCheck.

- Read-only: nothing in the panel can be changed.
- Tools are generated from the official @remnawave/backend-contract.
- Privacy filter on your computer: Reality keys, passwords, UUIDs and connection links are hidden; client usernames, e-mails, Telegram IDs, IPs and HWIDs are replaced with pseudonyms.
- The API token is stored in the system keychain.

prompts.name: daily_summary
prompts.description: Panel summary: users, online, offline nodes, traffic, expiring subscriptions

prompts.name: client_review
prompts.description: Subscription, devices, traffic and recent requests of one client

prompts.name: sharing_audit
prompts.description: Clients who probably share their subscription

prompts.name: node_check
prompts.description: Offline nodes, load balance, optional GeoCheck

api_token.title: API token / API-токен
api_token.description: Panel → Settings → API tokens. Grant read scopes only. Stored in the system keychain.

privacy.title: Privacy / Приватность
privacy.description: strict (recommended): secrets hidden + client data as pseudonyms; basic: only secrets hidden; off: raw data

privacy_salt.title: Pseudonym salt (optional)
privacy_salt.description: Any long random string — keeps pseudonyms the same after restarts. Leave empty for new pseudonyms each session.

api_key.title: X-Api-Key (optional)
api_key.description: Only if the panel is behind Caddy with a secret path and API key

cf_client_id.title: Cloudflare Access Client ID (optional)
cf_client_id.description: Only if the panel is behind Cloudflare Access

cf_client_secret.title: Cloudflare Access Client Secret (optional)
cf_client_secret.description: Only if the panel is behind Cloudflare Access
